summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found during a read-only audit (no code changed)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus the auth chain in `modules/auth/handlers.ts` and `db/auth.ts`.  Contrary to the ticket's assumption, I could **not** find an obvious wiring bug in this chain: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — it only reads/writes via `api.get/post/delete`, which always sends `credentials: "include"`. - Every watchlist
